pages.text: Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)Thrown tridents will inflict 15 seconds of Darkness, 15 seconds of Stun, and 15 seconds of Curse upon the target hit$(li)Effect lasts 10 minutes

Using the great trident, thorned vines, and the frigid glacier as guidance, one can find the Lord's dream.$(br)$(br)He stood, and shook the earth; he looked, and made the nations tremble. The eternal mountains were shattered, the ancient hills collapsed. — Habakkuk
